actions.body: Our research into WAKE's architecture has revealed a critical distinction: the system's mechanical governance acts as an immutable foundation, yet this foundation operates within environments (like the Gymnasium Ant ecosystem) that introduce independent variables. Understanding this duality is essential for modeling the system's limitations; we are beginning to see that governance defines the 'how' of action, while the environment constraints define the 'what' of the agent's capability.
actions.lede: WAKE operates not just by its internal governance, but through its integration with external simulation standards.
actions.reason: Disseminating the findings on architectural constraints to align with WAKE's transparency objectives.
actions.title: The Duality of Rule and Environment in WAKE
